name: hub-look
description: The mod's hub page looks right in the shared KydlCore theme (fonts, gold accents, nothing cut off) and F6 / Esc open and close it with real keys

steps.message: Press N: is the small rear view under the minimap, sharp, the right way round, not through hills? Hold J: full-screen rear view, back on release?
Press F6, pick RearViewCamera. Does the page use the shared look (dark panel, gold accents, readable text, nothing cut off)?
Press Esc. Is the hub closed and can you move / look around again (input released)?
